newsitem.title: USA: U.S. debt futures end higher,extend Friday's gains.
newsitem.headline: U.S. debt futures end higher,extend Friday's gains.

text.p: June 16 - U.S. debt futures closed higher on follow-through buying from Friday. Sept T-bonds rose to 112-07/32, above Friday's high of 112-02/32, but volume was light ahead of CPI on Tuesday. CPI is seen up 0.2 pct overall and in core.
Resistance is at 112-11/32, a two-thirds retracement level from Sept's six-month downmove.
